source: Toca Toca, a public dance challenge: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/HSug-0AAp3k (credited; the video is not redistributed). 492 frames at 30 fps, 1080x1920. Joints by RTMPose whole-body (rtmw-dw-x-l, 'balanced') through rtmlib and onnxruntime on the CPU; body-17 joints as COCO names them, renamed to body-18, neck = the shoulders' midpoint scored the lower of the two; a joint scored under 0.3 is 'occluded'. The dancer is the person with the largest vertical extent of body-17 joints scored at least 0.3 (at least five of them).
